features.label: Features
features.title: Everything you need to work with QR
features.desc: Powerful editor, flexible settings and analytics — all in one tool.

f1.title: Multiple Content Types
f1.desc: Support for popular formats for any task — from websites to business cards.

f2.title: Custom Design
f2.desc: Choose colors, corner and dot shapes, add your logo right in the center of the QR code.

f3.title: Scan Analytics
f3.desc: Track how many times and when your QR code was scanned in real time.

f4.title: Edit Without Replacement
f4.desc: Change the link or QR code data at any time — the code itself stays the same.

f5.title: Export & Storage
f5.desc: Download as PNG, SVG or PDF. All codes are stored in your account for reuse.

f6.title: Unlimited on Pro
f6.desc: The free plan has limits. A subscription removes all restrictions on the number of QR codes.
